archive_receipt.performed_by_note: NOT executed by a coordinator subagent. The coordinator role has no run_commands on this runtime, so it cannot stage, commit, or read a sha -- the same capability gap that stopped TASK-20260807-dcfaee halfway and the reason this campaign split fact-gathering (executor) from disposition (coordinator). Recorded rather than implied, because a receipt suggesting a coordinator subagent ran git would be false.
